subject: general
question: Dhamek stupa is one of the most prominent Buddhist structures in India. It is situated in the ________ district of Uttar Pradesh.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Varanasi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dhamek Stupa** is a massive stupa located at **Sarnath**, 13 km away from** Varanasi** in the state of **Uttar Pradesh, India**.
 
• Dhamek Stupa, also spelled** Dhamekh **and **Dhamekha,** can be translated as the** Stupa of the reign of Dharma**. 
 
• The Dhamek Stupa was built in** 500 CE**.
 
• The Dhamek Stupa is said to mark the spot where the Buddha gave the first sermon to his first five disciples.
 
• The wall of the stupa is covered with exquisitely carved figures of humans and birds, as well as inscriptions in the Brahmi script.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ramagrama stupa **is a stupa located in** Ramgram Municipality**, in the **Parasi District of Nepal**.
 
• **The Shanti stupa **is located in the midst of the presumed site of the Kalinga War in** Dhauli Hill in Odisha**.
 
• **Kesaria Stupa** is said to date back between 200 AD and 750 AD and may have been associated with the 4th-century ruler,** Raja Chakravarti.**
 
• **Mahabodhi Stupa** is located in** Bodh Gaya, Bihar**, and was built by** Ashoka the Great.**
 
• **The Ramabhar Stupa** in** Kushinagar **holds a significant place in the history of Buddhism being the cremation site of Lord Buddha.
